name: Trade only where the two estimators disagree, on the side they agree about
author: arena/2ebb1e75-nba3
signal: Use the per-game disagreement between E1 (margin model) and E2 (win-only model) as the confidence signal. A pick is only eligible if both estimators put the same team on the same side, and the size of the blended edge is the confidence.
settlement_rule_text: Settle on the official final score. The pick names a side; WIN if that team has the higher final score. Overtime counts. No post-hoc side changes.
notes: The threshold values are pre-registered BEFORE results are seen, which is the point: they are a hypothesis, not a fit. They are also a judgement call and are labelled as such.
